title: A Project Assessing the Safety and Feasibility of Using Panitumumab-IRDye800 as an Optical Imaging Agent to Detect Ovarian Cancer During Surgical Procedures
official: Pilot Project Assessing the Safety and Feasibility of Using Panitumumab-IRDye800 as an Optical Imaging Agent to Detect Ovarian Cancer During Surgical Procedures
summary: This is a pilot project to determine the safety and feasibility of using panitumumab-IRDye800 to detect cancerous tissue compared to normal surrounding tissue in participants with ovarian cancer undergoing surgical resection. This study is an extension of the work previously done using this agent in patients with squamous cell carcinoma (SCC) of the head and neck, exploring its utility in a different cancer type.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Biopsy-confirmed diagnosis of ovarian cancer.
2. Diagnosis of any stage.
3. Diagnosis of any histology.
4. Planning to undergo surgical resection via any modality (i.e., open, laparoscopic, robotic) with primary cytoreduction or interval debulking following neoadjuvant chemotherapy.
5. Age ≥ 18 years
6. ECOG 1
7. Have acceptable hematologic status, coagulation status, kidney function, and liver function including the following clinical results:

   1. Hemoglobin ≥ 9 gm/dL
   2. Absolute Neutrophil Count ≥ 1500
   3. White Blood Cell count \> 3000/mm3
   4. Platelet count ≥ 100,000/mm3
   5. Serum creatinine ≤ 1.5 times upper reference range

Exclusion Criteria:

1. Received an investigational drug within 30 days prior to first dose of panitumumab-IRDye800
2. Had within 6 months prior to enrollment: MI, CVA, or uncontrolled CHF
3. History of infusion reactions to any monoclonal antibody therapies
4. Pregnant or breast-feeding
5. Evidence of QT prolongation on pretreatment EKG (greater than 440 ms in males or greater than 450 ms in females)
6. Magnesium or potassium lower than the normal institutional values
7. Patients receiving Class IA (quinidine, procainamide) or Class III (dofetilide, amiodarone, sotalol) antiarrhythmic agents
8. Patients with a history or evidence of interstitial pneumonitis or pulmonary fibrosis
9. TSH \> 13 micro International Units/mL
